entities.name: Badr Shakir al-Sayyab
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Badr Shakir al-Sayyab was an Iraqi poet, regarded as one of the most important contemporary Arab poets. Alongside Nazik Al Malaika, he is considered one of the founders of Arab free-verse poetry.
